why_ai: Already AI-native software, but generative deepfakes and synthetic identities raise demand for verification.
why_clarity: Millions of pass-fail decisions in seconds, yet false rejects are silent and never measured.
why_digital: Phone images of documents and faces in, automated decisions out via API.

why_ai: Value rests on assembled credit header, telecom and address coverage that AI cannot generate.
why_clarity: Record linkage is a codified, high-volume task, but wrong matches surface only later.
why_digital: Records in, an identity match score out, all through APIs.

why_ai: A modelling race against a moving adversary whose AI-generated forgeries increase demand.
why_clarity: Genuine-or-forged and live-or-replay are defined outcomes, but undetected attacks stay hidden.
why_digital: Captured images of physical documents and faces in, model decisions out.

why_ai: Hand-maintained document templates are exactly what generalising vision models and change detection replace.
why_clarity: Each document revision has a fixed layout and security features that are checkable.
why_digital: Specimen documents in, a template library out, maintained on screen.

why_ai: Computing error rates by population is routine analysis; only the policy choice to publish is human.
why_clarity: The data exists and the method is routine, producing exact, reproducible error rates.
why_digital: Match scores and outcomes in, published statistics out.

why_ai: Accepting alternative evidence for an excluded person is an accountable, ambiguous call with high personal stakes.
why_clarity: Verified or not is clear, but whether the person was truthful often stays unknown.
why_digital: Mostly remote evidence review, with some cases needing a human or in-person route.

why_ai: Routing applicants across vendors is a learned decision layer that software performs.
why_clarity: Path success rates are measurable at volume, though false rejects remain partly hidden.
why_digital: Applicant attributes in, API routing decisions out.

why_ai: Credential issuers carry assurance liability and need relying-party trust, which deepfakes make more valuable.
why_clarity: Credential standards are codified and each presentation is verified cryptographically and instantly.
why_digital: Digital credentials issued and presented entirely online.

why_ai: Reviewers handle model-rejected edge cases, a pool that shrinks as vision models improve.
why_clarity: Genuine-or-not calls repeat by the minute, but reviewers never learn if they were right.
why_digital: Document images reviewed on screen, often by offshore review teams.

why_ai: Customer escalations rely on a trusted engineer, but case reconstruction and explanation are automatable.
why_clarity: Explanations are pieced together from logs and guesswork across composite scores.
why_digital: Logs and pipeline data in, explanations to customers out, all remote.

why_ai: Decisions are already automated, but AI-driven fraud keeps growing demand for the product.
why_clarity: Seconds-long pass-fail decisions at massive volume, with fraud outcomes and false rejects partly invisible.
why_digital: Images and identity records in, API decisions out, sold remotely.
